# Bitmap Overlay

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Display a bitmap image as a screen-space overlay.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/bitmap-overlay-widget",
  "type": "BitmapOverlayWidgetOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/bitmap-overlay-widget').par.image` (an input) and `op('/bitmap-overlay-widget').out.widget` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.image`, `out.widget`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

| `image` | `FileUrlField` | `""` |

| `width` | `NumberField` | `200` |
| `height` | `NumberField` | `200` |
| `opacity` | `NumberField` | `1` |
| `scale` | `NumberField` | `1` |
| `offsetX` | `NumberField` | `0` |
| `offsetY` | `NumberField` | `0` |
| `viewId` | `StringField` | `""` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->
